## What's new

- **CPU temperature in one click:** Settings → Desktop widgets → **Turn on CPU temperature**. NotchPC installs the free,
  signed PawnIO driver from Windows' official package catalog (winget) and lets its sensors run as administrator, after
  one Windows prompt. Windows itself cannot read the CPU temperature without such a driver.
- **Sensors restart reliably:** after turning the CPU temperature on (or off) the readings switch over by themselves,
  and if the sensors ever stop, NotchPC starts them again.
